pairs.why: The wagons are the same; A's dirt road with grass tufts and stones matches the real cards' lightly detailed scenes, while B's ground is a bare orange plane that looks unfinished.
This is q008 with the sides swapped: B has the detailed road with grass, and A has the empty flat ground.
B's red rim and hub match the bright red-and-white look of the real lighthouse and life ring, while A's grey metal wheel is duller and its stringy grass is the texture the lessons rejected.
This is q010 with the sides swapped: A has the red wheel and smooth ground, and B has the grey wheel and textured grass.
A's softer light and desert floor with a few shrubs and pebbles match the real gas-pump card's desert, while B's mesa has harsher contrast on bare, flat ground.
This is q012 with the sides swapped: B has the softer mesa with shrubs, and A has the high-contrast one on bare ground.
